title: Simon Ch. 2, 5.9 / Ch. 4, 2.7: the tangential divergence of the normal part of X is −X·H
statement: Let P be a natural number, Q ≤ S linear subspaces of ℝ^P with orthogonal projections p_Q and P_S (Submodule.starProjection), pr : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P), X, Y : ℝ^P → ℝ^P and x ∈ ℝ^P. Assume pr(x) = P_S, pr and X are differentiable at x, and Y(y) = X(y) − pr(y)(X(y)) for all y in a neighbourhood of x. Then trace(p_Q ∘ DY(x)) = −⟨X(x), Σ_{j=1}^P (Dpr(x)[p_Q e_j])^*(p_Q e_j)⟩, where e_1, …, e_P is the standard basis of ℝ^P (e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1), Dpr(x) ∈ L(ℝ^P, L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P)) is the derivative of pr at x, and T^* is the adjoint of T ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (pr : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (X Y : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), Q ≤ S → pr x = S.starProjection → DifferentiableAt ℝ pr x → DifferentiableAt ℝ X x → Y =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => X y - pr y (X y)) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ Y x).toLinearMap) = -inner ℝ (X x) (∑ j : Fin P, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ pr x (Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (Q.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))
